text:
alex: Quick sync on the console leftrail IA. I'm prototyping a compact 'mini-map' that groups Models + Datasets under a single parent to reduce noise. Sketch: https://staging.redwood/design/mini-map-compact.png

mei: I like the density win, but learner flow concerns. If we aggregate, can we still deep-link straight to models? Need canonical routes like `/console/w/:org/assets/models/:id`. Also consider adding a small badge or microcopy to clarify what's inside the group.

sam: Router/infra note: we'll support aliases for backwards compatibility. Proposed mapping:```js
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/assets/models/:id', code: 301 }
{ from: '/datasets/:id', to: '/assets/datasets/:id', code: 301 }
{ from: '/m/:id', to: '/assets/models/:id', code: 302 }
```We should persist UI state (split panels, active tab) in the querystring so deep links are reproducible.

rachel: Accessibility checklist: group toggle needs aria-expanded, aria-controls, and an aria-live update announcing "Assets expanded" / "Assets collapsed". Keyboard: support Enter/Space to toggle, arrow keys to navigate children, and ensure focus lands on the first child when expanded. Also add skiplink anchor for "Assets list" for screen reader users.

alex: Naming: 'Assets' is concise but bland. Alternatives: 'Data + Models', 'Model hub', 'Catalog'. My lean: use 'Assets' visually with tooltip text that reads "Models & Datasets" on hover/focus.

mei: Tooltip approach works. For onboarding, show a lightweight inline hint the first time: "Models moved to Assets  See what's changed" with a tour link. We should also support deep link query param to open the tour: `?tour=assets`

sam: Example deep link pattern: `/console/w/acme/assets/models/123?view=split&panel=metrics&tour=assets`. I'll add middleware that rewrites legacy shortlinks and capture querystring params for state hydration. Also, watch out for scroll-anchor losing position when the route updates  we might need preventDefault on some internal nav actions.

deploy-bot: preview-build: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/compact-mini-map (build 4892) :rocket:

rachel: From recent interviews, people said "I expect models at top-level". Recommend a gradual rollout: show a dismissible banner for 10 days "Models are now in Assets" with CTAs: "See new layout" + "Take tour". Track search fallbacks and CTA CTR. Also run a 50/50 label A/B: 'Assets' vs 'Data & Models'.

alex: Good. Action items: 
- @sam: implement route aliases, shortlink rewrites, persist split view state in querystring, and ensure scroll anchor behavior preserved.
- @mei: update the IA mocks, design tooltip text and banner variants, produce new compact iconography.
- @rachel: draft banner copy + research script for A/B and add accessibility acceptance criteria to the ticket.

Target: alpha on staging next Wednesday. Blockers?

mei: Small copy tweak suggestion for banner: "Models are now under Assets  View layout or take a guided tour." CTA: "Show me" / "Take tour"

sam: No infra blockers. I'll open a PR with redirect rules and a small middleware shim for legacy shortlinks.

rachel: I'll add keyboard flow test cases and screen reader notes to the ticket. Also confirm live-region text won't be too noisy during rapid toggles.

alex: Excellent. I'll pin the sketch and update the ticket with acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
